description: This file contains functions for loading content from URLs or files, handling errors, and copying files, used in the pykickstart project.

methods.name: load_to_str
methods.description: Loads content from a URL or file into a string, inferring type automatically.

methods.name: load_to_file
methods.description: Loads content from a URL or file and writes it to a destination file.

methods.name: _load_url
methods.description: Fetches content from a URL and returns it as a string.

methods.name: _load_file
methods.description: Reads a file's contents and returns as a string.

methods.name: _copy_file
methods.description: Copies a file to a specified destination.
